preregistration_correction: The first committed config contained a transcription error in the frozen gap-estimates SHA-256. Corrected to the artifact's computed digest before any screen outputs were generated; the method and thresholds are unchanged.
purpose: Reference-free partial-pooling sensitivity screen for uncertain zero-count facility types; not target-accuracy evidence, candidate promotion, or upload authorization.

frozen_inputs.official_ids: The four official sample files; consume GEOID only, never score placeholders.
frozen_inputs.provided_inputs: Use only pinned Overture tract summaries and strata inputs and the frozen C2 expected-count equations in the H1b registration. No removed reference layers, external data, labels, C0, or public/private scores.

fixed_method.facility_support_lambda: C2/H1b frozen expected facility count from provided population/urban features for each tract and type.
fixed_method.pooled_rate: Within each official region and facility type, min(1, sum of provided Overture raw type counts / sum of lambda); use all official tracts in that region.
fixed_method.zero_count_imputation: For raw Overture count 0, and kappa > 0, estimate provided-data rate (raw_count + kappa * pooled_rate) / (lambda + kappa), then gap=clip(1-rate,0,1) and include this imputed type in the facilities-half arithmetic mean. For kappa=0, preserve the frozen S2 rule and drop all raw-zero types.
fixed_method.nonzero_type: Keep frozen per-type gap estimate unchanged when raw count is positive and its frozen defined flag is true; otherwise omit it.
fixed_method.poi_composition: Arithmetic mean of defined facility half and frozen CBP-proxy half when each is defined; omit undefined halves.
fixed_method.composite: Arithmetic mean of defined frozen S2 transport/building and screen POI components; deterministic 0 only if all are undefined.
fixed_method.S2b_role: Read and hash-check S2b as a frozen comparator/input; do not modify it or use it as a target proxy.
fixed_method.support_summaries: Report total-screen composite changes by region and mean facility lambda bin; also single-type attribution by region and that type's lambda bin.
fixed_method.outputs: Kappa 0/2/5 official-row predictions; max absolute change against frozen S2 by region/type/support bin; undefined/zero counts, bounds, deterministic file hashes.
fixed_method.accuracy_claim: None; no target labels or valid local target holdout exist.
